networkCondition: Playwright offline emulation after cache preparation; uncached requests rejected in both contexts
checks: separate browser contexts create independent persisted identities
names and avatars replace raw identifiers in the default interface
a real downloaded QR card adds a contact without entering a key
legacy contact cards still import with explicit source confirmation
camera denial gives an image/file fallback without changing identity
closing while camera permission is pending stops a late stream
a tampered contact file is rejected and cannot enable Add contact
encrypted chat crosses isolated stores by file, with safe text rendering
duplicate delivery adds no second message
reordered JSON fields remain the same authenticated message
tampered ciphertext is rejected without changing message history
message content is stored as ciphertext and private keys remain nonextractable
the chat-only service worker caches and controls both pages
uncached server requests fail in both browser contexts
offline reload retains separate keys and decrypts saved conversations
QR decoding and contact matching work after an offline reload
an earlier outgoing packet can be saved again after offline reload
a reply can be created and opened while both browser contexts are offline
the actual exchange scenario executes in the offline browser
saved message file contains the encrypted packet
desktop, narrow and landscape layouts have no horizontal overflow
no unhandled browser errors
scope: Windows desktop Chromium only; manual packet handover, no physical phones or BLE.
